legal_access.note: NHANES public-use data are permissible for local exploratory methods work; this is NOT evidence of authorization for HUNT data.

secure_environment.note: Input/output confinement under ignored data/ and artifacts/ exists in source, but institutional security attestation is separate.

privacy_disclosure.note: Local-only experiment contracts and source-only CI restrictions are present; never publish participant or model records.

stakeholder_question.note: Exploratory mortality benchmark defined; no real NTNU clinical decision owner, intervention or prospective use yet.

population_sampling.note: Development cohort eligibility and examination-only linkage follow-up reconciled by local read-only checks; selection bias remains.

provenance_versions.note: v0.19 data hash and public-use source provenance pinned; v0.20 PFQ lineage/source checks.

data_integrity.note: Development labels and PFQ features reconciled; this is not a complete audit of all wave/site data quality.

missingness_mechanisms.note: PFQ walking/stairs skips and code 5 reconciled; other variables and nonresponse require separate codebooks.

wave_site_harmonization.note: Later cycles and future HUNT waves require independent instrument, timing, coding and measurement equivalence review.

outcome_index_horizon.note: Approximate 60-month mortality label reconciled; public-use follow-up times can be synthetic. Cannot claim exact death timing.

followup_censoring.note: Code excludes alive participants censored before 60 months; public-use follow-up perturbation remains a limitation.

observation_grain.note: One row per participant in frozen NHANES case; new repeated visit projects must use specialized designs.

predictor_availability.note: Verify that each clinical predictor is recorded before or at the intended prediction index for the study.

leakage_prevention.note: Source defines forbidden target/ID/time features and case-specific cohort split restrictions.

splits_and_holdout.note: 2013-2014 cohort was previously inspected; never claim independent pristine test based on that cohort.

missingness_processing.note: PFQ-specific status/category encoding improved repeated development CV but cannot be transferred automatically.

candidate_models.note: v0.16 included logistic, histogram boosting, Random Forest, XGBoost and CatBoost as exploratory comparison.

tuning_and_reproducibility.note: Versioned nested selection, stability and source-encoding designs exist; folds reuse development participants.

class_imbalance_sample_size.note: Document prevalence, effective sample-size/power, event-per-parameter and optimism relative to intended use.

survey_and_cluster_design.note: NHANES design weights and clustered variance not built into the v0.16-v0.21 comparisons.

discrimination_and_error.note: Brier, ROC-AUC, AP, log loss are computed on development folds, not independent evaluation.

calibration_and_proper_scores.note: v0.17-v0.18 calibration and proper scoring experiments are exploratory; sigmoid not promoted.

clinical_decision_utility.note: Exploratory threshold/decision-quality diagnostics exist but do not establish clinical utility.

uncertainty_and_robustness.note: Plan valid clustered/survey intervals, participant bootstrap and sensitivity analysis where applicable.

subgroups_fairness.note: Plan enough events per group, multiple comparison safeguards, intersectional equity and privacy rules.

external_transportability.note: Obtain genuinely independent new-site or temporal data under approvals and frozen protocol before performance claims.

transparent_reporting.note: Create TRIPOD+AI manuscript table, study diagram and fully specified methods for actual assignment.

bias_applicability.note: Perform separate PROBAST+AI judgments for development and evaluation with named assessors.

figures_reproducibility.note: Local aggregate diagnostic reports and source CI exist; a frozen manuscript-grade result bundle is not yet assembled.

limitations_communication.note: Development reuse, inspected holdout, timing perturbation and no clinical validation stated in method documents.

deployment_scope.note: The current NHANES system is research-only; no patient-level decision service or clinical deployment allowed.

drift_monitoring.note: There is no deployed clinical or population risk-prediction model to monitor at this time.

handoff_and_ownership.note: Assign responsible PI, domain expert, analyst, source custodian, sign-off and incident escalation for actual NTNU study.
